module.summary: Load-time auto-localization: overrides VFS.Include/VFS.LoadFile to rewrite global namespace accesses (Spring/Script/gl/math etc.) into locals (gated by the AutoLocalizeLua config, on by default).

VFS.Include.desc: Overrides VFS.Include: loads the file, applies the localization rewrite, loadstrings it, runs it in enviroment (the caller's env when omitted) and returns the chunk result; returns nil when the file cannot be read.

VFS.LoadFile.desc: Overrides VFS.LoadFile: reads the file and, when the name contains '.lua', returns the auto-localized source string; otherwise returns the raw content.

LoadFileSafe.desc: Calls the originally saved VFS.LoadFile directly (bypassing the override) to avoid recursion.

fileDesc: Overrides VFS.Include/VFS.LoadFile to auto-localize global namespace accesses at load time for speed.
